free_tier.stated: '$50 in free credits at signup, no credit card required. Concurrency is capped (see above) until you upgrade.' At the Universal-2 pre-recorded rate of USD 0.15 an hour, 50 / 0.15 = 333 hours of transcription. At Universal-3.5 Pro (USD 0.21 an hour) the same credit is 238 hours.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: a free runner plus 333 hours of pre-recorded transcription is enough to transcribe a whole lecture or podcast archive once; pair it with a free object store from the storage lane for the audio, since the credit covers the API and nothing else. What breaks: the 5-stream streaming cap makes live capture useless, and a re-transcription after a model change spends the credit twice.

limits.value: the free tier caps streaming concurrency at '5 new streams per minute' against 100 for pay-as-you-go, so five live sessions a minute is the real wall on a free account, long before 50 dollars of credit is spent.
